latestVersion.changelog:
8004-skill-monad v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides tools to register and manage ERC-8004 Identity NFTs on Monad for CEO Protocol and ERC-8004–integrated flows.
- Includes complete documentation for on-chain ERC-8004 Identity Registry contract (address, functions, events) and JSON registration template.
- Offers ready-to-use scripts for identity registration, card building, IPFS upload, URI setting, and verification with environment variable support.
- Details standard flow for agent registration and best practices for recording agent identity information.
- Includes minimal contract ABI for integration and scripting.
